blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: The adoption of CMOS sensors in mobile photography is frequently compromised by the rolling shutter (RS) effect, which introduces geometric distortions and motion artifacts. Particularly, recent rolling shutter with global reset (RSGR) mode, while mitigating some RS issues, also incurs major limitations, including reduced capture speed and compressed dynamic range. To address these problems, we propose a novel dual reversed scanning setup utilizing both RSGR and inverted RSGR views. This solution not only handles the inherent flaws of RSGR by synchronizing complementary exposures to balance the dynamic range across the frames but also introduces an effective method for HDR photosequencing under highly dynamic scenes. Our proposed network first accommodates row-wise complementarity and manages visual shifts by row-adaptive feature alignment. Subsequently, the hallucination module, built upon a correlation-guided mix-attention block, integrates the mutually reinforced features to recover missing details. In addition, we construct a coaxial imaging system to collect a real-world dataset, enabling robust training and evaluation beyond numerical simulation. Experimental results demonstrate the twofold benefits of our solution in mitigating RSGR limitations and advancing HDR reconstruction techniques.
blocks.zh: 在移动摄影中采用CMOS传感器经常受到滚动百叶窗(RS)效应的影响,该效应引入几何扭曲和运动文物. 特别是最近采用全球重置模式的滚动百叶窗,虽然减轻了某些RS问题,但也产生了重大限制,包括捕获速度下降和动态范围压缩。 为了解决这些问题,我们提议采用新的双重反向扫描装置,同时使用RSGR和反向RSGR两种观点。 这个解决方案不仅通过同步互补曝光以平衡跨帧动态范围,处理RSGR的固有缺陷,而且还引入了HDR在高度动态场景下进行摄影的有效方法. 我们提议的网络首先兼顾到逐行的互补性,并且通过逐行调整功能来管理视觉转变。 随后,以关联导的混音-注意力块为基础的幻觉模块整合了相互增强的特性以恢复缺失的细节. 此外,我们建造了一个同轴成像系统,以收集一个现实世界的数据集,从而能够进行超出数字模拟的强力训练和评价。 实验结果表明,我们的解决办法在减少登记册系统管理人和推进人类发展报告重建技术方面具有双重好处。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: With the widespread use of digital cameras and smartphones, increasing attention has been paid to choosing imaging sensors that balance performance and cost. Compared with Charge-Coupled Devices (CCD), Complementary Metal-Oxide Semiconductor (CMOS) sensors dominate the consumer market due to their low power consumption, high data rate, and ease of integration ( Vasu et al., 2018 ; Schubert et al., 2019 ) , and have become fundamental to visual computing ( Kirillov et al., 2023 ; Ji et al., 2018 ; Ye et al., 2020 ; Zhao et al., 2025 ) . However, under dynamic objects or ego-motion, their row-wise scanning mechanism produces rolling shutter (RS) effects, degrading both appearance and geometry. As a result, mitigating RS effects has become an essential problem for robust scene understanding and reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 随着数码相机和智能手机的广泛使用,人们越来越注意选择兼顾性能和成本的成像传感器. 与充电耦合装置(CCD)相比,辅助金属-氧化半导体(CMOS)传感器因其功率消耗低,数据率高,集成方便而主导消费市场(Vasu等人,2018年;Shubert等人,2019年),已经成为视觉计算的基础(Kirillov等人,2023年;Ji等人,2018年;Ye等人,2020年;Zhao等人,2025年). 然而,在动态物体或自我运动下,它们的逐行扫描机制会产生滚动的百叶窗效应(RS),同时降低外观和几何特征. 因此,减轻斯普斯卡共和国的影响已成为对现场的深刻理解和重建的一个基本问题。

blocks.en: Traditional RS correction methods ( Albl et al., 2020 ; Zhuang et al., 2017 ; Lao and Ait-Aider, 2018 ; Purkait et al., 2017 ; Rengarajan et al., 2016 ) rely on velocity assumptions or geometric constraints, which struggle to capture real camera motion and scene geometry. Deep learning-based approaches have achieved impressive performance for single ( Zhuang et al., 2019 ; Yan et al., 2023 ) and multi-frame inputs ( Liu et al., 2020a ; Ringaby and Forssén, 2012 ; Fan et al., 2023 ; Qu et al., 2023 ; Niu et al., 2024 ) . Recent works ( Fan and Dai, 2021 ; Fan et al., 2022 ; Zhong et al., 2022a ) further attempt to recover multiple latent frames from RS inputs, but the ill-posed nature of the problem still leads to ghosting and motion artifacts. To handle this issue, the global-reset feature of RS sensors (RSGR) ( Wang et al., 2022 ; Ji et al., 2023a ; Ji et al., 2023b ) has been exploited to reformulate RS correction as a more tractable deblurring problem, achieving superior results. But meanwhile, the RSGR mode introduces two overlooked limitations: (1) the merit of RS mode over global shutter (GS) in capture speed is sacrificed because early scanning of the next frame is not allowed anymore (Figure 1 a); and (2) row-variant exposure causes dynamic-range compression (Figure 1 b). Unlike conventional RS with constant row exposure, RSGR increases exposure duration row by row, leading to under-exposure at the top and over-exposure at the bottom when scanning downward.
blocks.zh: 传统的RS校正方法(Albl等人,2020年;Zhuang等人,2017年;Lao and Ait-Aider,2018年;Purkait等人,2017年;Rengarajan等人,2016年)依赖于速度假设或几何限制,它们努力捕捉真实的相机运动和场景几何. 深度学习方法在单项( Zhu等人,2019年; Yan等人,2023年)和多框架投入(刘等人,2020年a;林加比和福森,2012年;范等人,2023年;邱等人,2023年;牛等人,2024年)上取得了令人印象深刻的业绩. 近期作品(Fan and Dai, 2021;Fan et al., 2022;Zhong et al., 2022a)进一步试图从RS输入中回收多具潜伏的帧,但问题的不合理性质仍然导致幽灵和运动文物. 为了处理这一问题,利用RS传感器(RSGR)的全球重置特性(Wang等人,2022年;Ji等人,2023年a年;Ji等人,2023年b年b年),将RS校正重新编订为更易操作的脱落问题,取得了优异的结果。 但与此同时,RSGR模式引入了两个被忽略的限制:(1)RS模式在捕捉速度方面优于全球百叶窗(GS)的优点被牺牲,因为不再允许提前扫描下一帧(图1a);(2)行变量曝光会导致动态测距压缩(图1b). 与常规的RS有恒列曝光,RSGR会逐行增加曝光持续时间,导致在向下扫描时头部接触不足,底部接触过多.

blocks.en: Figure 1 : Limitations of RSGR mode and our dual reversed setting. (a) shows capturing process of two consecutive frames from RSGR and RS sensors. Enabling the global reset feature deprives RS mode of early scanning and causes the delay of a readout time. (b) presents acquired frames from two types of sensors. The dynamic range of RSGR is lower than that of RS. In (c), we reconstruct an HDR video clip from two row-wise complementary observations captured by spatiotemporally aligned RSGR (scanning downwards) and iRSGR (scanning upwards) cameras, which well addresses two issues of RSGR mode and provides a novel solution for HDR reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 图1:RSGR模式的限制和我们的双反向设置. (a) 从RSGR和RS传感器显示连续两个帧的捕获过程。 启用全局重置功能剥夺了RS模式的早期扫描功能,并导致读出时间的延迟. (b) 介绍从两种传感器获得的框架。 RSGR的动态范围低于RS. 在(c)中,我们重建了从两个逐行补充观测中获取的《人类发展报告》视频剪辑,即快速对齐的RSGR(扫描向下)和iRSGR(扫描向上)相机,这些相机很好地处理了RSGR模式的两个问题,为《人类发展报告》的重建提供了新的解决办法。

blocks.en: Existing HDR approaches cannot be directly applied, because they depend on alternating-exposure LDR sequences combined with motion compensation ( Kang et al., 2003 ; Chen et al., 2021 ) or feature alignment ( Chung and Cho, 2023 ; Liu et al., 2022 ) . Such methods remain vulnerable to distortions and ghosting under fast motion, making them ineffective for handling the limitations. Inspired by ( Albl et al., 2020 ) , we propose a dual reversed setting simultaneously capturing two fully aligned RSGR and inverted RSGR (iRSGR) views to reconstruct a sequence of clear frames with high speed and high dynamic range (HDR photosequencing), which not only well-addresses two aforementioned issues but also provides a novel solution for HDR reconstruction in dynamic scenarios. As shown in Figure 1 c, the corresponding rows in the two views provide complementary exposures for the same visual content under static conditions. Although the middle scanlines may converge to similar intensity levels, missing contrast can be compensated by the hallucination capability of our model. In dynamic scenes, visual shifts between corresponding rows may weaken this complementarity. However, such shifts are typically minor due to the short exposure time, and our method remains robust to them. Meanwhile, these shifts also alleviate intensity convergence in the middle rows. Our experiments in Section 4.3 confirm these conclusions. Since this row-wise complementarity holds in both static and dynamic scenes, our dual reversed RSGR setup ultimately enables high-frame-rate acquisition, mitigates motion degradation, and makes dynamic-range expansion more tractable.
blocks.zh: 现有的人类发展报告方法不能直接应用,因为它们取决于交替暴露的LDR序列与运动补偿相结合(Kang等人,2003年;Chen等人,2021年)或特征对齐(Chung and Cho,2023年;Liu等人,2022年)。 这种方法仍然容易被歪曲,在快速运动下消失,因而无法有效处理这些限制。 在(Albl等人,2020年)的启发下,我们提议采用双重反向设置,同时捕捉两个完全一致的RSGR(RSGR)和倒置的RSGR(IRSGR)观点,以重建一系列具有高速和高动态范围的清晰框架(HDR phosequencing),这不仅很好地处理了上述两个问题,而且还为HDR在动态情景下的重建提供了新的解决方案. 如图1c所示,两种观点中的相应行在静态条件下为相同的视觉内容提供了互补的曝光. 虽然中间扫描线可能与相似的强度水平汇合,但缺失的对比可以通过我们模型的幻觉能力来弥补. 在动态场景中,相应行之间的视觉转变可能会削弱这种互补性. 然而,由于接触时间短,这种变化通常不大,而且我们的方法对它们来说仍然有力。 同时,这些转向还缓解了中行的强度趋同. 我们在第4.3节的实验证实了这些结论。 由于这种逐行互补在静态和动态场景中都存在,我们双重反转的RSGR设置最终能够实现高帧率的获取,减缓运动降解,使动态射程扩展更便于牵引.

blocks.en:
Following the hardware design of ( Zhong et al., 2022a ; Ji et al., 2023b ; Ji et al., 2024 ; Ji et al., 2026 ) , we construct our optical system to capture aligned high-speed sharp HDR videos and low-speed RSGR-iRSGR pairs. Assisted by the collected dataset, we further propose an end-to-end framework for HDR photosequencing. Firstly, the Row-adaptive Feature Alignment module (RFA) conducts multi-scale, row-shaped attention to better adapt the row-wise complementarity and simultaneously manage the visual shifts under highly dynamic scenes. Subsequently, the hallucination module generates sharp details, especially for under/over-exposed rows. To this end, we introduce a residual correlation-guided mix-attention block (RCMB), built upon parallel streams, which aggregates intra-stream self-similar features and supports cross-stream mutual compensation. Finally, a tri-pivot temporal loss on the luminance channel emphasizes geometric consistency and suppresses color variations, improving temporal coherence in the reconstructed video.
In summary, the main contributions of our paper are: • We design a dual-reversed RSGR configuration that inherently accommodates fast motions, addressing intrinsic limitations of RSGR mode, and simultaneously offering a competitive solution to robustify HDR reconstruction. • We construct a special imaging system that simultaneously captures RSGR-iRSGR pairs along with their corresponding high-speed HDR videos, and collect a high-quality real dataset of outdoor dynamic scenes. • We introduce a novel neural network architecture consisting of a row-adaptive feature alignment and a hallucination module based on correlation-guided mix-attention block. Extensive experiments have validated the effectiveness of our setting and model.
blocks.zh:
根据硬件设计(钟等,2022a;姬等,2023b;姬等,2024;姬等,2026),我们构建了我们的光学系统,以捕捉对齐的高速锐利HDR视频和低速RSGR-IRSGR对. 在所收集的数据集的协助下,我们进一步提出了《人类发展报告》摄影的端到端框架。 首先,RFA(英语:Row-adaptive Feature Official Module (RFA))进行多尺度的,排状的注意,以更好地调整逐行互补,同时在高度动态的场景下管理视觉转变. 随后,幻觉模块会产生尖锐的细节,尤其是对于接触不足/过度接触的行来说. 为此,我们引入了一个基于平行流的剩余关联导混合关注区块(RCMB),该区块汇总了流内自相仿的特征,支持跨流互换补偿. 最后,光辉通道上的一个三极时间损失强调几何一致性并抑制色彩变异,改善了重建视频中的时间一致性.
简而言之,我们的文件的主要贡献是: 我们设计了一种双重转换的RSGR配置,内在地适应快速运动,解决RSGR模式的内在局限性,同时提供一种竞争性的解决办法,加强人类发展报告的重建。 我们构建一个特殊的成像系统,同时捕捉RSGR-iRSGR对及其相应的高速HDR视频,并收集室外动态场景的高质量真实数据集. ^ 我们引入了新型神经网络架构,由一个行适应性特征对齐和一个基于相关-导混合-注意块的幻觉模块组成. 广泛的实验证实了我们设置和模型的有效性。

blocks.en: 2.1 Rolling Shutter Correction and Interpolation
blocks.zh: 2.1 滚动关卡校正和内插

blocks.en: The causing effects of rolling shutters under ego-motion or dynamic scene are often non-negligible. Early works model RS geometry ( Meingast et al., 2005 ) to improve SfM and correct distortions using discrete epipolar constraints ( Dai et al., 2016 ) or differentiable warping ( Zhuang et al., 2017 ) , but they rely on strong assumptions about scene structure or camera motion, such as Manhattan-world layouts ( Purkait et al., 2017 ) , straight-line preservation ( Rengarajan et al., 2016 ) , purely rotational ( Lao and Ait-Aider, 2018 ; Ringaby and Forssén, 2012 ) or translational motion ( Liang et al., 2008 ; Baker et al., 2010 ) . These priors limit their applicability in real scenes. Albl et al. ( Albl et al., 2020 ) later introduce a dual reversed RS configuration that provides additional geometric constraints from sparse correspondences.
blocks.zh: 在自我感动或动态场景下滚动百叶窗的诱因往往不可忽略. 早期的作品模型RS几何(Meingast et al.,2005年),用离散的顶极约束(Dai et al.,2016年)或异形摆动(Zhuang et al.,2017年)改进SfM和纠正扭曲,但它们依赖于对场景结构或相机运动的强烈假设,如曼哈顿-世界布局(Purkait et al.,2017年),直线保护(Rengarajan et al.,2016年),纯粹旋转. (老挝和Ait-Aider,2018年;Ringaby和Forssén,2012年)或翻译运动(梁等人,2008年;贝克等人,2010年). 这些前科限制了它们在真实场景中的适用性. 阿尔布尔等人. (Albl et al., 2020)后来引入了双重反转的RS配置,提供了稀少的通信的额外几何限制.

blocks.en: Learning-based approaches ( Naor et al., 2022 ; Zhou et al., 2022 ; Fan et al., 2021 ; Zhuang et al., 2019 ) instead estimate motion fields to warp RS images toward their GS counterparts. Liu et al. ( Liu et al., 2020a ) propose a shutter-unrolling network with differentiable warping, while Qu et al. ( Qu et al., 2023 ) solve complex nonlinear motion with a quadratic RS model. Fan et al. ( Fan et al., 2023 ) jointly recover appearance and motion in a single-stage design, and the global-reset mode has also been exploited for video ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and single-image correction ( Ji et al., 2023a ) . More broadly, RS interpolation or temporal super-resolution ( Fan and Dai, 2021 ; Fan et al., 2022 ; Zhong et al., 2022a ) reconstructs multiple latent sharp frames within a single RS exposure, and Ji et al. ( Ji et al., 2023b ) provide a unified comparison across degradations. Nevertheless, RS correction fundamentally requires shifting each scanline to a virtual GS coordinate frame based on estimated flow or hallucinated context, making existing methods fragile in the presence of large or complex motions.
blocks.zh: 基于学习的方法(Naor等人, 2022年;Zhou等人, 2022年;Fan等人, 2021年;Zhuang等人, 2019年)相反,估计运动场将RS图像向GS对应方扭曲. 刘等. (Liu et al.,2020a) 提出采用异步摇摆的百叶窗-不卷摆网络,而Qu et al. (Qu et al., 2023)用四元RS模型解决复杂的非线性运动. 范 al等. (Fan等人,2023年)在单阶段设计中联合恢复外观和运动,全球重置模式也被用于视频(Wang等人,2022年)和单像校正(Ji等人,2023年a年). 更广泛地说,RS内插法或时间超解(Fan and Dai, 2021;Fan et al, 2022;Zhong et al, 2022a)在一次RS曝光中重建了多种潜在锐框,Ji等人. (Ji等人,2023b)提供了对降解的统一比较. 尽管如此,RS校正从根本上要求将每条扫描线转向基于估计流量或幻觉背景的虚拟GS坐标框架,使现有方法在出现大型或复杂运动时变得脆弱.

blocks.en: 2.2 High Dynamic Range Imaging
blocks.zh: 2.2 高动态 区域映射

blocks.en: Regardless of HDR video reconstruction or multi-exposure imaging, the goal is to merge motion-varying LDR frames into a clean HDR result. Traditional HDR pipelines focus on alignment to avoid ghosting: motion rejection methods ( Khan et al., 2006 ; Heo et al., 2010 ; Zhang and Cham, 2011 ; Oh et al., 2014 ; Lee et al., 2014 ) first register LDR inputs and then discard misaligned pixels, often suppressing useful information and degrading HDR quality. More robust techniques use optical flow ( Kang et al., 2003 ; Zimmer et al., 2011 ) or energy minimization ( Sen et al., 2012 ; Hu et al., 2013 ) , but they remain time-consuming and sub-optimal due to complex optimization.
blocks.zh: 无论HDR视频重建或多曝光成像,目标是将运动变化的LDR帧合并到一个干净的HDR结果中. 传统的HDR管道注重对齐以避免幽灵:运动拒绝方法(Khan等人,2006年;Heo等人,2010年;Zhang and Cham,2011年;Oh等人,2014年;Lee等人,2014年)首先登记LDR输入,然后丢弃错位像素,经常压制有用的信息,降低HDR的质量. 更强力技术使用光学流(Kang等人,2003年;Zimmer等人,2011年)或能量最小化(Sen等人,2012年;Hu等人,2013年),但由于复杂优化,这些技术仍然耗时且不理想.

blocks.en: Deep learning has significantly advanced HDR imaging. CNN- and Transformer-based methods ( Kalantari et al., 2017 ; Cai et al., 2018 ; Wu et al., 2018 ; Yan et al., 2019 ; Yan et al., 2020 ; Niu et al., 2021 ) alleviate misalignment and reduce ghosting, even enabling single-image HDR reconstruction ( Chen et al., 2023 ; Marnerides et al., 2018 ; Liu et al., 2020b ) . Kalantari et al. ( Kalantari et al., 2017 ) pioneer optical-flow-guided HDR fusion; Wu et al. ( Wu et al., 2018 ) avoid explicit motion estimation via image translation. Chen et al. ( Chen et al., 2021 ) develop a coarse-to-fine alignment and fusion framework using their collected real dynamic HDR data. More recent works include context-aware Transformers ( Liu et al., 2022 ) and luminance-based alignment with hallucination modules ( Chung and Cho, 2023 ) for enhanced detail recovery.
blocks.zh: 深入学习已大大推进了《人类发展报告》的成像。 CNN-和变形金刚基于方法(Kalantari等人,2017年;Cai等人,2018年;Wu等人,2018年;Yan等人,2019年;Yan等人,2020年;Niu等人,2021年)缓解错位和减少鬼魂,甚至能够进行单像HDR重建(Chen等人,2023年;Marnerides等人,2018年;Liu等人,2020年b). Kalantari等人. (Kalantari等人,2017年) 先驱光学-流导HDR聚变; Wu等人. (Wu等人,2018年)避免通过图像翻译进行明确的运动估计. 陈等. (Chen等人,2021年)利用他们收集的真正动态HDR数据,制定粗细对齐和聚变框架. 较近期的作品包括具有上下文感知的变形器(Liu等人,2022年)和基于亮度的与幻觉模块的对接(Chung and Cho, 2023年),以加强细节恢复.

blocks.en: Some methods employ event cameras ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2021 ) to reconstruct HDR videos, but such systems are often costly or vulnerable to large motions. In contrast, our dual reversed RSGR configuration is simple to implement and provides improved robustness under dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: 一些方法使用事件摄像头 (Lin等人,2023年;Zou等人,2021年)重建HDR视频,但这类系统往往成本高昂或易受大动作影响. 相比之下,我们两个反向的RSGR配置执行起来很简单,在动态场景下提供了更好的稳健性.

blocks.en: Figure 3 : (a) shows the overall architecture containing two parts: alignment module registers motions between reversed RSGR views, and hallucination module generates sharp details, especially for under/over-exposed rows. blocks.en:
To train our model, we require spatially aligned and temporally synchronized RSGR-iRSGR observations together with corresponding high-frame-rate HDR ground truths. Therefore, we develop a novel quad-axis imaging system and collect a real-world dataset, RSGR-HDR. Each capture provides a dual reversed RSGR pair and two sets of high-speed GS frames for composing HDR GTs. To the best of our knowledge, such real-world data have not been explored in prior work. Our entire
hardware prototype is illustrated in Figure 2 . Two RSGR cameras (FLIR BFS-U3-63S4C) with reversed scanning direction share the identical objective scenes with two high-speed GS cameras (BITRAN CS-700C) through a beam splitter group. The RSGR sensors enlarge pitch size from 2.4 ​ μ ​ m 2.4~\mu m to 9.6 ​ μ ​ m 9.6~\mu m through 4 × 4 4\times 4 binning, while GS cameras incorporate SONY IMX426 sensor with air-forced cooling. We follow the merging strategy in ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2021 ) to combine the GS pairs with different scene irradiance into HDR measurements.

blocks.en: To perform HDR photosequencing from dual reversed RSGR views, we propose a two-stage framework comprising feature alignment and hallucination modules, as shown in Figure 3 a. Given strictly aligned RSGR–iRSGR pair, shallow convolutions first extract their feature maps X t X_{t} and X b X_{b} . Row-shaped attention is then applied at multiple scales to handle visual shifts under large motion and to promote mutual compensation between the two views. Features aligned with row sizes 𝒓 \bm{r} and strides 𝒔 \bm{s} are dynamically fused to accommodate varying motion magnitudes. The hallucination module further aggregates these aligned features using a Transformer-based encoder–decoder to recover fine details in under- or over-exposed regions. Finally, a reconstruction block outputs a high-speed HDR sequence 𝑯 = { H i , i = 0 , 1 , ⋯ , N − 1 } \bm{H}=\{H^{i},i=0,1,\cdots,N-1\} within the exposure duration of input. N is the length of reconstructed latent video.

blocks.en: Normally, attention-based alignment will attend to all tokens without selection or adhering to epipolar constraints. However, to effectively adapt and fully leverage our dual reversed RSGR configuration, several considerations need to be addressed. As discussed in ( Ji et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2022 ) , the unique distortion induced by RSGR mode is naturally row-dependent. Indiscriminate processing tends to corrupt the temporal cues implicitly embedded by sequential readout mechanism. Second, the observed RSGR and iRSGR views are inherently row-wise corresponding, facilitating robust alignment even under large motions. Furthermore, applying dense attention across the entire feature space ( Figure 4 a) leads to high computational demands and potential ambiguities in motion registration. Therefore, we propose row-shaped attention to highlight these concerns. Nevertheless, direct use of row-wise attention with fixed scale (Figure 4 b), e.g. simply associating corresponding rows between views ( Shi et al., 2021 ; Li et al., 2024 ) is only suitable for ideal static scenes. To handle the varying visual shifts under dynamic cases, we propose row-adaptive feature alignments ( Figure 4 c) that effectively blend multiple scales. For clarity, we proceed to explain with 𝒓 = [ 3 , 4 , 5 ] \bm{r}=[3,4,5] and 𝒔 = [ 2 , 3 , 4 ] \bm{s}=[2,3,4] .
blocks.zh: 通常情况下,基于关注的调整将涉及所有符号,而不进行选择或遵守极化限制。 然而,为了有效地调整和充分利用我们双重逆转的RSGR配置,需要考虑若干因素。 如(Ji等人,2023a)所述; Wang et al., 2022 ),RSGR模式引致的独特扭曲自然依赖行. 不分青红皂白的处理往往会腐蚀顺序读出机制所隐含的时间提示。 第二,所观察到的RSGR和IRSGR观点本质上是逐行对应的,即使在大型运动下也有利于进行有力的调整。 此外,对整个地物空间进行密集的注意(图4a)会导致高计算要求和移动登记中潜在的模糊之处。 因此,我们建议按行形注意突出这些关切。 尽管如此,直接使用有固定比例尺的行式注意(图4b),例如简单地将相应的行连接到观点之间(Shi等人,2021年;Li等人,2024年),只适合理想的静态场景. 为了处理动态病例下的各种视觉变化,我们提议采用可有效混合多个尺度的行适应特征调整(图4c)。 为了清楚起见,我们将用 r = [3, 4, 5]\bm{r}= [3,4, 5] 和 s = [2, 3, 4]\bm{s}= [2, 3, 4] 来解释。

blocks.en: To enhance the generation ability of local details, we further propose novel correlation-guided mix-attention Transformer layer with dual streams. Therefore, the aggregated features of both views can be mutually improved more effectively from perspective of global context. The calculated correlation volume ( Sun et al., 2018 ) between two views explicitly represents the similarities, which has merits of driving the features in each stream to become more compatible with those of the other. To this end, we build the cross-attention module aided by the correlation volume as the major supplementary to original self-attention. Overall, our proposed mix-attention effectively adapts to self-similar features within a single stream while also enabling reciprocal interactions across different streams.
blocks.zh: 为了增强本地细节的生成能力,我们进一步提出有双流的新型关联导变形器层. 因此,可以从全球角度更有效地改进这两种观点的综合特点。 两种观点之间计算出的关联体积(Sun等人,2018年)明确代表了相似性,这有推动每个流中的特征与另一流的特征更加兼容的优点. 为此,我们构建了由相关量辅助的交叉关注模块,作为原始自我关注的主要补充. 总体而言,我们提议的混合意向有效地适应了单一流内的自我相似特征,同时也使不同流间的相互作用成为可能。

blocks.en: 4.1 Comparison with SOTA methods
blocks.zh: 4.1 与SOTA方法的比较

blocks.en:
We aim to reconstruct a sequence of HDR frames from dual reversed RSGR views with intermediate degradation between RS effects and blur. Therefore, we compare our model with related SOTA methods from: • Blur interpolation and decomposition: BiT ( Zhong et al., 2023 ) , AfB ( Zhong et al., 2022b ) and DeMFI ( Oh and Kim, 2022 ) approximate motions based on temporally adjacent blurry frames. We also include the typical interpolation method, RIFE ( Huang et al., 2022 ) and more competitive setting by using the combination of blur frame and corresponding event streams, EBFI ( Weng et al., 2023 ) and UniINR ( Lu et al., 2024 ) . • RS correction and interpolation: CVR ( Fan et al., 2022 ) , RSSR ( Fan and Dai, 2021 ) , DSUN ( Liu et al., 2020a ) and JAMNet ( Fan et al., 2023 ) take as input multiple RS frames while IFED ( Zhong et al., 2022a ) depends on dual reversed RS views and EvUnroll ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) requires extra event information. • RSGR undistortion and interpolation: NGS ( Wang et al., 2022 ) and RSS-T ( Ji et al., 2023a ) reconstruct single sharp output while PMBNet ( Ji et al., 2023b ) can interpolate at arbitrary time. • HDR reconstruction: LAN ( Chung and Cho, 2023 ) , HDRFlow ( Xu et al., 2024 ) and ExpandNet ( Marnerides et al., 2018 ) follow convention by alternating exposures of input LDR frames. EFI ( Lin et al., 2023 ) absorbs complementary information from the RS image and events to retrieve a HDR sequence. To better demonstrate the superiority of our setup, we also adapt RIFE, IFED and BiT to dual RSGR inputs, which are denoted as RIFE m , IFED m , and BiT m , {}_{m}, respectively. As a contrast, RIFE, IFED and BiT represent models using consecutive RSGR frames.
Importantly, following prior work ( Mertens et al., 2007 ; Lin et al., 2023 ; Chen et al., 2025 ) , we adopt an exposure-fusion strategy for HDR composition. Unlike conventional pipelines that reconstruct a linear HDR image followed by tone mapping, we directly output tone-mapped LDR results, avoiding error accumulation ( Chen et al., 2025 ) . Accordingly, methods are evaluated using PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS and TMQI ( Yeganeh and Wang, 2012 ) , rather than linear-HDR metrics such as PSNR-PU, SSIM- μ \mu or HDR-VDP.

blocks.en: After retraining all models on RSGR-HDR, we present experimental results in Table 1 . Our method outperforms all existing approaches across diverse setups by a large margin (at least 1.5 dB on PSNR). Overall, algorithms designed for motion degradation fail under extreme overexposure or underexposure conditions, while HDR methods cannot handle motion distortions in dynamic scenes. The significant improvements of RIFE m , IFED m , and BiT m over their corresponding baselines (RIFE, IFED, and BiT) clearly demonstrate the effectiveness and generalizability of our dual reversed setup. The qualitative comparison in Figure 5 further validates that our method can simultaneously expand dynamic range and reconstruct visual details from motion degradation. We further present the inference-time computational cost of all models in Table 1 , measured on a single NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 with an input size of 640 × 480 640\times 480 . The results demonstrate that our model attains the highest perceptual and fidelity scores while remaining competitively efficient.
blocks.zh: 在对RSGR-HDR的所有模型进行再培训之后,我们在表1中提出了实验结果。 我们的方法在各种设置上的表现大大超过所有现有方法(在PSNR上至少是1.5分贝)。 总的来说,为运动降解设计的算法在极端过度接触或接触不足的条件下失败,而HDR方法无法处理动态场景中的运动扭曲. RIFE m、IFED m和BiT m在相应基线(RIFE、IFED和BiT)上的重大改进清楚地表明了我们双重反向设置的有效性和普遍性。 图5中的定性比较进一步证实,我们的方法可以同时扩大动态范围,从运动降解中重建视觉细节. 我们进一步提出表1中所有模型的推算时间计算成本,在单NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090上测量,输入大小为640×480 640\时. 结果显示,我们的模型在保持竞争效率的同时,获得了最高的认知和忠诚分数。

blocks.en: To assess the efficacy of proposed structure in our model, we conduct ablation studies as depicted in Table 2 . We first remove feature alignment ( V 1 V_{1} ), and then successively replace our row-adaptive strategy with the dense and row-wise counterparts ( V 2 V_{2} and V 3 V_{3} ). The performance significantly drops in all metrics. We also observe that the Swin Transformer block ( V 4 V_{4} ) fails to capture the complementarity between RSGR-iRSGR views. Although incorporating temporal loss in the sRGB space leads to certain improvements ( V 5 V_{5} vs. V 6 V_{6} ), the gains remain limited. In contrast, our proposed tri-pivot loss contributes substantially to the final performance. We also compared with frequently used warping-based temporal constraint ( Lai et al., 2018 ) . Figure 6 demonstrates consistent findings from qualitative aspect. Moreover, we perform ablation study on row shapes used in feature alignment to explore the optimal hyper-parameters. As shown in Table 3 , our model is retrained with different combinations of row size r r and stride s s , which further proves the effectiveness of our tailored design.

blocks.en: 4.3 Visual Shifts and Convergent Exposures
blocks.zh: 4.3 视觉变化和接触

blocks.en: As discussed in Section 1 , the exposure convergence in the middle rows of RSGR-iRSGR views may complicate HDR expansion, but missing contrast can be compensated by our model. On the other hand, random visual shifts between corresponding rows are inevitable due to physical misalignments and fast motion. Such shifts, in turn, effectively mitigate the exposure-convergence issue. Meanwhile, our dual setting normally equips some tolerance to these constrained visual shifts ( Zhong et al., 2022a ; Ji et al., 2024 ) . To prove this, we randomly shift the RSGR view in the image space along the horizontal and vertical axes, with maximal translational offsets as 4 , 6 , 8 4,6,8 pixels, respectively. We then retrain our model using these misaligned pairs and present comparisons in Table 4 and Figure 7 . The results reveal no significant performance drop, validating that our dual-view setup and customized model remain robust to dynamic scenes, where motion-induced spatial displacement helps alleviate central exposure convergence and limits its impact on reconstruction quality.
blocks.zh: 如第1节所述,RSGR-IRSGR观点中间一行的曝光趋同可能使人类发展报告的扩展复杂化,但缺失的对比可以用我们的模型弥补。 另一方面,由于物理上的错位和快速运动,相应行之间的随机视觉转变是不可避免的. 反过来,这种转变又有效地减轻了接触趋同问题。 同时,我们的双重设定通常为这些受限制的视觉转变提供一定的耐力(Zhong等人,2022a; Ji等, 2024 (英语). 为了证明这一点,我们随机将图像空间中的RSGR视图沿水平轴和垂直轴移动,最大翻译偏移为4,6,8,4,6,8像素. 然后,我们利用这些错配对重新训练我们的模型,并在表4和图7中提出比较。 结果显示没有出现显著的性能下降,这证明我们的双景设置和定制模式对动态场景依然有力,其中运动引起的空间迁移有助于减缓中央接触的趋同,并限制其对重建质量的影响。

blocks.en: 5 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 5 结论

blocks.en: In this paper, we present a new task of HDR photosequencing from dual reversed RSGR inputs, addressing the inherent limitations of RSGR in frame rate and dynamic range. By exploiting the row-wise complementary property, our framework enables robust feature alignment and dynamic range expansion even under large motions. We also construct an optical system to collect dual reversed RSGR observations with sharp HDR sequences, and develop a network with row-adaptive alignment, mix-attention hallucination, and tri-pivot structural supervision, achieving improved detail recovery and reduced temporal flickering. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real data validate the effectiveness of our proposed setting and model, demonstrating clear advantages over existing solutions.
blocks.zh: 在本文中,我们提出了从双重逆转的RSGR投入中进行HDR摄影的新任务,解决RSGR在帧率和动态范围的固有局限性。 我们的框架通过利用逐行互补的属性,即使在大动作下也能使特性得到有力的调整和动态范围扩大。 我们还建造了一个光学系统,以收集带有尖锐的HDR序列的双重反向RSGR观测数据,并开发一个具有排位调整、混合意向幻觉和三中枢结构监督的网络,实现更好的细节恢复和减少时间闪烁。 有关合成和真实数据的广泛实验验证了我们提议的设置和模型的有效性,显示出与现有解决办法相比的明显优势。

blocks.en: A.1 Construction of Imaging system

blocks.en: To construct a realistic dataset that contains perfectly aligned RSGR, iRSGR, and high-speed HDR video streams, we begin by fixing the RSGR camera and manually tuning the pose of the remaining cameras. This is guided by inspecting checkerboard residuals. However, achieving sub-pixel alignment for all four cameras across every axis proves extremely challenging due to the intricate nature of the multi-sensor rig. As a result, we eventually lock all components of the system in place and perform the alignment computationally. Specifically, we follow strategy in ( Rim et al., 2020 ) and estimate three homographies under a closed-loop constraint to synchronize the viewpoints of the four sensors. The detailed specifications and acquisition parameters for each device are listed in Table A.1 .
blocks.zh: 为了构建一个包含完全一致的RSGR,iRSGR,以及高速HDR视频流的现实数据集,我们首先要修复RSGR相机,并手动调整其余相机的姿势. 这是通过检查机柜残存物来指导的。 然而,由于多传感器钻机的复杂性质,在每个轴线上实现所有四个相机的子像素对齐,证明极具挑战性。 因此,我们最终将系统的所有组件锁定在原位,并通过计算执行对齐. 具体地说,我们遵循战略(Rim等人,2020年),在闭路限制下估计三个同位素,以同步四个传感器的观点。 每个装置的详细规格和购置参数见表A.1。

blocks.en: The GS camera used in our system—BTRAN CS-700C equipped with a SONY IMX426 sensor—exhibits very low noise. Two factors mainly contribute to this. First, the IMX426 increases its effective pixel size to 9 ​ μ ​ m × 9 ​ μ ​ m 9\mu m\times 9\mu m by combining four 4.5 ​ μ ​ m × 4.5 ​ μ ​ m 4.5\mu m\times 4.5\mu m subpixels at the circuit level, resulting in high sensitivity and reduced read noise. Second, the camera is actively cooled to 0 ∘ ​ C 0^{\circ}\mathrm{C} , which further suppresses thermally induced noise.

blocks.en: To ensure that the system remains feasible in practice, we pair the imaging device with a FUJINON HF12.5HA-1S lens (focal length 12.5 mm, supporting 2/3-inch formats). Given the effective pixel pitch of 9 ​ μ ​ m 9\mu m , the active sensing region of 640 × 480 640\times 480 corresponds to 5.7 ​ m ​ m × 4.3 ​ m ​ m 5.7mm\times 4.3mm . blocks.en: We follow the method proposed in ( Lin et al., 2023 ; Zou et al., 2021 ) to merge the two GS frames into HDR image. One of the high-speed sensors is fitted with a Thorlabs ND513B neutral-density filter to attenuate incoming light. ND filters reduce irradiance uniformly in both spatial and spectral domains. This enables us to record two GS frames with different illumination levels without altering exposure duration, which is often difficult to control reliably when capturing at high frame rates. The two complementary exposures provide the necessary variation for synthesizing HDR results.
blocks.zh: 我们遵循(Lin等人,2023年;Zou等人,2021年)中提议的方法,将两个GS框架合并为HDR图像. 其中一种高速传感器装有Thorlabs ND513B中性密度滤波器,以减弱光线。 ND滤波器在空间和光谱领域均统一减少辐射。 这使得我们能记录两个具有不同照明水平的GS帧,而不会改变曝光时间,在以高帧速率捕获时往往难以可靠控制。 这两种相辅相成的接触为综合人类发展报告的结果提供了必要的差异。

blocks.en: A.2.1 Real Dataset
blocks.zh: A.2.1 实际数据集

blocks.en: The comprehensive methodology for collecting our real data is detailed in Section 3.1 . Utilizing the capabilities of our imaging system, we collected the RSGR-HDR dataset, which comprises 90 urban scenes. Each scene includes 70 × 2 70\times 2 degraded frames and 1,400 aligned high-speed sharp frames. As shown in Table A.1 and Figure A.1 , each RSGR–iRSGR pair is acquired over a 40 ms cycle, consisting of a 20 ms exposure followed by a 20 ms dead time. Meanwhile, the two GS cameras operate at 500 fps with a 2 ms exposure and no dead time, producing 20 synchronized GS pairs per cycle. Ten pairs fall within the RSGR–iRSGR exposure window and are fused into 10 temporally aligned HDR frames, while the remaining ten fall within the dead time. Therefore, in RSGR-HDR, each RSGR–iRSGR pair corresponds to 10 HDR GT frames. Representative RSGR-HDR samples are illustrated in Figure A.2 . The visual discrepancies between the two views are distinctly noticeable. The mutually inverted scanning manner allows the exposure compensation, which provides supplemental details and cues for robust HDR reconstruction. We further divide them into 54, 12 and 24 sequences as our training, validating, and testing set, respectively.
blocks.zh: 第3.1节详述了收集我们真实数据的全面方法。 我们利用我们的成像系统的能力,收集了RSGR-HDR数据集,其中包括90个城市场景。 每个场景包括70×2 70\times 2退化帧和1400对齐的高速锐帧. 如表A.1和图A.1所示,每对RSGR-IRSGR是经过40ms周期获得的,包括20ms接触,然后是20ms死亡时间。 同时,两台GS摄像头以500英尺的高度运行,接触量为2ms,没有死时,每个周期产生20对同步的GS配对. 10对属于RSGR-IRSGR暴露窗口,并结合成10个时间上一致的人类发展报告框架,而其余10对则属于死期。 因此,在RSGR-HDR中,每个RSGR-iRSGR配对对应10个HDR GT框架. 图A.2列示了RSGR-HDR的代表性样本。 两种观点之间的视觉差异明显可见。 相互反向扫描方式使接触补偿成为可能,为强有力的人类发展报告重建提供了补充细节和提示。 我们进一步将它们分为54、12和24个序列,分别作为我们的培训、鉴定和测试的组合。

blocks.en: A.2.2 Synthetic Dataset
blocks.zh: A.2.2 合成数据集

blocks.en: To strengthen our study of how dual reversed RSGR setting aids HDR photosequencing, we also developed a synthetic dataset called GOPRO-Dual, adhering to the methodologies specified in ( Ji et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . While synthetic data cannot fully capture the complexity and diversity of real-world scenes, it is used here only for supplementary and independent validation. Our main training and evaluation are conducted on the real-world RSGR-HDR dataset. Meanwhile, experiments on synthetic data further verify our findings and provide a meaningful reference for specific analyses (e.g., ensuring fair comparison across methods). This dataset draws from the GOPRO data ( Nah et al., 2017 ) , which encompasses 33 videos with a resolution of 1280 × 720 1280\times 720 . Each video features 1200 consecutive frames shot at 240fps. To render the dataset more lifelike, we significantly enhanced the framerate of the GOPRO videos, increasing them by a factor of × 64 \times 64 through a widely-used video interpolation algorithm ( Huang et al., 2022 ) .
blocks.zh: 为了加强我们对双重逆转的RSGR设置如何辅助HDR摄影的研究,我们还开发了一个名为GOPRO-Dual的合成数据集,并坚持采用(Ji等人,2023a); Wang et al., 2022 ).  Wang. 虽然合成数据不能完全捕捉现实世界场景的复杂性和多样性,但这里只用于补充和独立验证. 我们的主要培训和评价是在现实世界的RSGR-HDR数据集上进行的。 同时,关于合成数据的实验进一步验证了我们的调查结果,并为具体分析提供了有意义的参考(例如,确保各种方法之间的公平比较)。 该数据集来自GOPRO数据(Nah等人,2017年),包含33个视频,分辨率为1280×720 1280\times 720. 每段视频均以2200帧连续镜头拍摄,拍摄时间为240fps. 为了让数据集更像生命,我们大幅提升了GOPRO视频的帧率,通过一个广泛使用的视频插值算法(Huang等人,2022年),将视频的帧率提升到x64\times 64。

blocks.en: Figure A.3 illustrates our synthesizing method. We formulate the imaging process of RSGR as weighted sum of patches extracted from corresponding latent sharp frames within exposure time τ \tau ( Ji et al., 2023a ; Wang et al., 2022 ) . RSGR view is synthesized with scanning direction from top to bottom, while iRSGR exposes frames upwards. We strictly constrain the generation process as shown in Figure A.3 , the two reversed RSGR views are aligned in frame level to ensure they observe the identical visual content of scenes. Specifically, the original GOPRO frames are centrally cropped as 512 × 512 512\times 512 and we set T = τ = 512 T=\tau=512 , which leads to 512 sharp frames corresponding to an RSGR or iRSGR frame. For enabling supervised learning, we uniformly sampled 9 frames out of them to take as ground truth. Figure A.4 exhibits some examples of synthesized data.
blocks.zh: 图A.3说明了我们的合成方法。 我们将RSGR的成像过程定为在接触时间\ tau(Ji等人,2023a); Wang et al., 2022 ).  Wang. RSGR视图由上到下通过扫描方向合成,而iRSGR则向上曝光帧. 如图A.3所示,我们严格限制生成过程,两个反向的RSGR视图在框架层面对齐,以确保它们观测到场景相同的视觉内容. 具体地说,最初的GOPRO帧被集中裁剪为512×512 512\times 512,我们设置了T = \ \ \ = 512 T = 512 T = 512,这导致了512个与RSGR或iRSGR帧相对应的锐框. 为了能够有监督地学习,我们统一抽取了其中的9个框架,以作为基本真理。 图A.4显示了一些综合数据的例子。

blocks.en: In the experiments, we compared our method with some competitive settings: EFI ( Lin et al., 2023 ) , EvUnroll ( Zhou et al., 2022 ) and EBFI ( Weng et al., 2023 ) assisted by event camera , LAN ( Chung and Cho, 2023 ) using alternating exposure within an input sequence. However, our collected dataset: RSGR-HDR and GOPRO-Dual, exclude the event or multi-exposure counterpart. Thus, we synthesized the event stream from the high frame-rate videos using an event simulator ( Gehrig et al., 2020 ) . The alternating exposure sequence could be generated based on the HDR frames through mapping strategy provided in ( Chen et al., 2021 ) .
blocks.zh: 在实验中,我们用一些竞争环境来比较我们的方法:EFI(Lin等人,2023年),EvUnroll(Zhou等人,2022年)和EBFI(Weng等人,2023年),由事件摄像头协助,LAN(Chung和Cho,2023年)在一个输入序列中采用交替曝光. 然而,我们收集的数据集:RSGR-HDR和GOPRO-Dual,不包括事件或多接触对应方。 使用事件模拟器(Gehrig等人,2020年), 通过(Chen等人,2021年)提供的绘图战略,可以根据人类发展报告框架生成交替接触序列。

blocks.en: A.2.3 Training Details
blocks.zh: A.2.3 培训细节

blocks.en: During learning process, each training sample consists of RSGR-iRSGR pairs and a HDR video clip with frame length of 9 9 . We adopt Adam optimizer ( Kingma and Ba, 2014 ) with initial learning rate of 10 − 4 10^{-4} combined with a cosine annealing scheduler. The total training epoch is set as 800 800 . To augment data, training samples are randomly cropped to 256 × 256 256\times 256 , then flipped vertically and horizontally. The whole training process is performed on two GPUs of NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090 with batch size of 8. Conventionally, we assess the performance of our models using established metrics: PSNR, SSIM, and LPIPS.
blocks.zh: 在学习过程中,每个培训样本包括RSGR-IRSGR配对和框架长度为9 9的人类发展报告录像片段。 我们采用了亚当优化器(Kingma和Ba,2014年),初始学习率为10 - 4 10 - 4 + - 4 + 3 + 余弦反射排程器。 培训的总时间定为800 800。 为了增加数据,培训样本被随机收成256×256256\times 256,然后垂直和横向翻转. 整个训练过程是在NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5090的两个GPU上进行的,批量尺寸为8. 在常规方面,我们使用既定的衡量标准评估我们的模型的绩效:PSNR、SSIM和LPIPS。

blocks.en: B.2 Third-party Evaluation
blocks.zh: B.2 第三方评价

blocks.en: To further evaluate the generalization ability of our framework, we additionally construct two third-party testsets, Adobe-Dual and LiU-HDRv-Dual, based on Adobe240 ( Su et al., 2017 ) and the LiU HDRv ( Kronander et al., 2014 ) , respectively. Adobe-Dual contains diverse scene contents, motion patterns, illumination conditions, and synthesis parameters that differ from those of our training data, while LiU-HDRv-Dual is introduced to evaluate the performance of our method on conventional HDR scenes with pronounced illumination variations, dark regions, and saturated highlights. Following the same dual reversed RSGR imaging pipeline described in Section A.2.2 , we synthesize the corresponding RSGR-iRSGR observations and HDR targets for both testsets. In all experiments, the pretrained model is directly evaluated without any finetuning or domain adaptation.
blocks.zh: 为了进一步评价我们框架的总体化能力,我们又根据Adobe240(Su等人,2017年)和LiU HDRv(Kronander等人,2014年)分别构建了两个第三方测试台,Adobe-Dual和LiU-HDRv-Dual。 Adobe-Dual包含与我们训练数据不同的场景内容,运动模式,照明条件,以及合成参数,而LiU-HDRv-Dual则被引入来评价我们的方法在常规HDR场景上的性能,具有明显的照明变异,黑暗区域,饱和亮点. 根据A.2.2节所述相同的双重反向RSGR成像管道,我们综合了相应的RSGR-IRSGR观测结果和两个测试台的人类发展报告目标。 在所有实验中,经过预先训练的模型都是直接评价的,没有进行任何微调或域调整.

blocks.en: Table B.3 and Figure B.6 present the quantitative and visual comparisons on Adobe-Dual, demonstrating the robustness of our method to unseen scenes, motions, synthesis parameters, and illumination conditions. Meanwhile, the results on LiU-HDRv-Dual in Table B.4 and Figure B.7 further verify its generalization to conventional HDR scenes with challenging underexposed and overexposed regions. On both testsets, our method achieves the best overall performance and consistently reconstructs fine temporal details with a wide dynamic range.
blocks.zh: 表B.3和图B.6介绍了关于Adobe-Dual的定量和视觉比较,显示了我们的方法对看不见的场景、运动、合成参数和照明条件的强烈性。 同时,表B.4和图B.7关于LiU-HDRv-Dual的结果进一步证实,它将其概括到传统的HDR场景中,具有挑战性的未充分暴露和过度暴露的区域。 在两个测试中,我们的方法都取得了最佳的整体性能,并不断以广泛的动态范围重建精细的时间细节。

blocks.en: These results suggest that the superiority of our framework does not mainly originate from overfitting to a specific dataset distribution, but rather from the intrinsic row-wise complementary property of dual reversed RSGR inputs (BiT vs. BiT m ) together with the proposed row-adaptive alignment and correlation-guided hallucination modules (Ours vs. BiT m ).
blocks.zh: 这些结果表明,我们框架的优越性并非主要源于过于适合特定的数据集分布,而是源于RSGR输入(Bit vs. BiT m)双向反转(Bit vs. BiT m)输入的内在的逐行补充属性,以及拟议中的行调整和关联引导幻觉模块(Wurs vs. BiT m.).

blocks.en: B.3 Video reconstruction results
blocks.zh: B.3 录像重建成果

blocks.en: To better substantiate the temporal consistency of our model in HDR photosequencing, we apply our model and competitive SOTAs to generate multiple consecutive latent HDR frames, whose visual results on GOPRO-Dual are given in  Figure B.8 . In terms of motion prediction, EFI fails to distinguish the movement of waving hand throughout all latent frames. The other approaches, such as PMBNet, EvUnroll and DeMFI, are able to disambiguate temporal direction but also introduce significant artifacts and distortions. Compared with BiTm, our results are clearer and closer to ground truths. Consistent observation can be found in the real data presented in Figure B.9 .
blocks.zh: 为了更好地证实我们的模式在《人类发展报告》中的时间一致性,我们采用我们的模型和竞争性的SOTA来产生多个连续的潜在的《人类发展报告》框架,其关于GOPRO-Dual的视觉结果见图B.8。 在运动预测方面,EFI未能区分挥手在所有潜在框架上的移动. 其他方法,如PMBNet、EvUnroll和DeMFI,能够分解时间方向,但也引入了重要的文物和扭曲。 与BiTm相比,我们的成果更明确,更接近地面真理. 在图B.9所示的实际数据中可以看到一致的观测结果。
